# Reference — earlier material (read-only)

Archived copies of material that came **before** the production build. Kept for reference only.
**Do not edit, build from, or deploy anything in this folder.** The live project is the rest of this repo.

| Folder / file | What it is | Still valid? |
|---|---|---|
| `tuasl-fashion-demo/` | The static HTML/CSS/JS demo shown to the client (TU@SL branding, template switcher, dummy data, demo admin). Includes `Client/` (draft proposals, content checklist) and `Bug/` (demo bug screenshots and Levi's UX reference screenshots). | **Feature reference only.** Every feature on its pages is kept in the real build, but its code, branding, maroon theme and templates are not reused. See `docs/02-scope-baseline.md` §I for what was removed. |
| `client-documents/` | Client source documents: the signed budget proposal `Spencer-Denim-Ecommerce-Website-Budget-Proposal.pdf` (TU2SL-2026-0823) and `Refrence sites/refernce.txt` (theme reference: Banana Republic). | **Yes. The signed proposal is the scope source of truth.** |
| `TUASL_Fashion_Claude_HTML_Prototype_Prompt.md` | The original brief used to generate the demo (Max Fashion reference, static-only stack). | **No.** Historical only. Superseded by `docs/01`–`08`. |

Notes:
- These are copies taken on 2026-09-16. The working originals stay in `D:\Projects\e com\` (outside the repo).
- The repository is **private** because these files contain client names and pricing. Keep it private.
- Some demo asset folders were empty and are not tracked by git. The demo loaded its images from remote URLs.
- The client progress page (`client-progress/`) is managed separately and is not archived here.
